+"""Tests for accompanied/age rules in admit()."""
+from lido import admit
+
+
+def make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0):
+    return {"kind": kind, "capacity": capacity, "admitted": admitted}
+
+
+def make_swimmer(name="Alice", age=20, member=False, accompanied=False):
+    return {"name": name, "age": age, "member": member, "accompanied": accompanied}
+
+
+class TestAccompaniedRule:
+    def test_child_under_eight_unaccompanied_refused(self):
+        """Swimmer under 8 without an adult is refused."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=7, accompanied=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+    def test_child_under_eight_accompanied_admitted(self):
+        """Swimmer under 8 with an adult is admitted when space available."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=7, accompanied=True)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_eight_year_old_unaccompanied_admitted(self):
+        """8 is old enough to go in alone."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=8, accompanied=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_eight_year_old_accompanied_admitted(self):
+        """8-year-old can go in with or without an adult."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=8, accompanied=True)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_older_child_unaccompanied_admitted(self):
+        """Older children can go in without an adult."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=12, accompanied=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_older_child_accompanied_admitted(self):
+        """Older children admitted regardless of accompanied status."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=12, accompanied=True)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_unaccompanied_rule_checked_before_places(self):
+        """Unaccompanied child under 8 refused, not waiting."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=10)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=7, accompanied=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+    def test_unaccompanied_rule_at_boundaries(self):
+        """Test exact boundaries for accompanied rule."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        # 7 unaccompanied
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer(age=7, accompanied=False)) == "refused"
+        # 8 unaccompanied
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer(age=8, accompanied=False)) == "admitted"
+        # 7 accompanied
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer(age=7, accompanied=True)) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_accompanied_status_irrelevant_for_old_swimmers(self):
+        """Accompanied status doesn't matter for 8+."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=1, admitted=0)
+        swimmer_unaccompanied = make_swimmer(age=20, accompanied=False)
+        session["admitted"] = 1
+        # If there's no space and they're 20, they wait regardless
+        assert admit(session, swimmer_unaccompanied) == "waiting"

+"""Tests for place availability logic in admit()."""

+
+
+def make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0):
+    return {"kind": kind, "capacity": capacity, "admitted": admitted}
+
+
+def make_swimmer(name="Alice", age=20, member=False, accompanied=False):

+
+
+class TestPlaceAvailability:
+    def test_member_admitted_when_any_place_free(self):
+        """Member is admitted while any place is free."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=9)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_non_member_admitted_when_two_places_free(self):
+        """Non-member needs a second place held for a member."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=8)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_non_member_waiting_when_one_place_free(self):
+        """Non-member cannot use the last place (reserved for member)."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=9)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_member_waiting_when_session_full(self):
+        """Member waits when no places free."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=10)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_non_member_waiting_when_session_full(self):
+        """Non-member also waits when no places free."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=10)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_single_place_session_member_admitted(self):
+        """Single-place session holds that place for a member."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=1, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_single_place_session_non_member_waiting(self):
+        """Single-place session reserves place for member."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=1, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_single_place_session_full_member_waiting(self):
+        session = make_session(capacity=1, admitted=1)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_many_places_all_free_member_admitted(self):
+        session = make_session(capacity=100, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_many_places_all_free_non_member_admitted(self):
+        session = make_session(capacity=100, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_two_place_session_both_free(self):
+        """Two places: member admitted, non-member admitted (one left for member)."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=2, admitted=0)
+        member = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        non_member = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, member) == "admitted"
+        assert admit(session, non_member) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_two_place_session_one_taken_by_member(self):
+        """One place free after member takes one."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=2, admitted=1)
+        non_member = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, non_member) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_place_logic_independent_of_session_kind(self):
+        """Place logic applies same way to all session kinds (for eligible swimmers)."""
+        # Members can use last place in all session kinds
+        for kind in ["family", "club", "lane"]:
+            session = make_session(kind=kind, capacity=10, admitted=9)
+            member = make_swimmer(age=16, member=True)
+            assert admit(session, member) == "admitted"
+
+        # Non-members need 2 free places (in sessions where they're eligible)
+        for kind in ["family", "lane"]:
+            session = make_session(kind=kind, capacity=10, admitted=9)
+            non_member = make_swimmer(age=16, member=False)
+            # Non-member needs 2 free places, so waiting when only 1 free
+            assert admit(session, non_member) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_place_calculation_with_full_capacity(self):
+        """When session is full, no places free."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=5)
+        member = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        non_member = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, member) == "waiting"
+        assert admit(session, non_member) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_exact_place_boundaries(self):
+        """Test exact boundaries of place availability."""
+        # Capacity 3: 2 free
+        session = make_session(capacity=3, admitted=1)
+        non_member = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, non_member) == "admitted"  # 2 free, needs 2
+
+        # Capacity 3: 1 free
+        session = make_session(capacity=3, admitted=2)
+        non_member = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, non_member) == "waiting"  # 1 free, needs 2

+"""Tests for ValueError cases in admit()."""
+import pytest
+from lido import admit
+
+
+def make_session(kind="lane", capacity=10, admitted=0):
+    return {"kind": kind, "capacity": capacity, "admitted": admitted}
+
+
+def make_swimmer(name="Alice", age=20, member=False, accompanied=False):
+    return {"name": name, "age": age, "member": member, "accompanied": accompanied}
+
+
+class TestValidationOfSession:
+    def test_invalid_kind_raises(self):
+        session = make_session(kind="invalid")
+        swimmer = make_swimmer()
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no such session"):
+            admit(session, swimmer)
+
+    def test_capacity_zero_raises(self):
+        session = make_session(capacity=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer()
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no places"):
+            admit(session, swimmer)
+
+    def test_capacity_negative_raises(self):
+        session = make_session(capacity=-1)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer()
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no places"):
+            admit(session, swimmer)
+
+    def test_admitted_negative_raises(self):
+        session = make_session(admitted=-1)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer()
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="more swimmers"):
+            admit(session, swimmer)
+
+    def test_admitted_exceeds_capacity_raises(self):
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=11)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer()
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="more swimmers"):
+            admit(session, swimmer)
+
+    def test_admitted_equals_capacity_is_valid(self):
+        session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=5)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        result = admit(session, swimmer)
+        assert result in ("admitted", "waiting", "refused")
+
+
+class TestValidationOfSwimmer:
+    def test_negative_age_raises(self):
+        session = make_session()
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=-1)
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="younger than nought"):
+            admit(session, swimmer)
+
+    def test_zero_age_is_valid(self):
+        session = make_session()
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=0)
+        result = admit(session, swimmer)
+        assert result in ("admitted", "waiting", "refused")
+
+    def test_large_age_is_valid(self):
+        session = make_session()
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=100)
+        result = admit(session, swimmer)
+        assert result in ("admitted", "waiting", "refused")

+"""Integration tests covering rule interactions and edge cases."""
+from lido import admit, roll_call
+
+
+def make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0):
+    return {"kind": kind, "capacity": capacity, "admitted": admitted}
+
+
+def make_swimmer(name="Alice", age=20, member=False, accompanied=False):
+    return {"name": name, "age": age, "member": member, "accompanied": accompanied}
+
+
+class TestRuleInteractions:
+    def test_club_rule_takes_precedence_over_age(self):
+        """Club membership checked before age."""
+        session = make_session(kind="club", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        # Old non-member refused before checking they're old enough
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=40, member=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+    def test_club_rule_takes_precedence_over_accompanied(self):
+        """Club membership checked before accompanied rule."""
+        session = make_session(kind="club", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        # Young unaccompanied non-member: refused for membership, not accompanied
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=5, member=False, accompanied=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+    def test_lane_rule_takes_precedence_over_accompanied(self):
+        """Lane age rule checked before accompanied rule."""
+        session = make_session(kind="lane", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        # Accompanied young swimmer refused for age, not for being accompanied
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=10, accompanied=True)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+    def test_accompanied_rule_takes_precedence_over_places(self):
+        """Accompanied rule checked before place availability."""
+        session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=100, admitted=0)
+        # Unaccompanied under-8 refused even with lots of space
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=5, accompanied=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "refused"
+
+    def test_all_rules_satisfied_then_admitted(self):
+        """When all rules pass, swimmer is admitted if space."""
+        session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        swimmer = make_swimmer(age=30, member=False, accompanied=False)
+        assert admit(session, swimmer) == "admitted"
+
+
+class TestBoundaryConditions:
+    def test_exactly_at_capacity(self):
+        """Session at exactly full capacity."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=5)
+        member = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        non_member = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, member) == "waiting"
+        assert admit(session, non_member) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_one_below_capacity(self):
+        """One place free."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=4)
+        member = make_swimmer(member=True)
+        assert admit(session, member) == "admitted"
+        non_member = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, non_member) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_two_below_capacity(self):
+        """Two places free."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=5, admitted=3)
+        non_member = make_swimmer(member=False)
+        assert admit(session, non_member) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_age_boundary_fifteen_sixteen(self):
+        """Test boundary between 15 and 16 for lane."""
+        session = make_session(kind="lane", capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer(age=15)) == "refused"
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer(age=16)) == "admitted"
+
+    def test_age_boundary_seven_eight(self):
+        """Test boundary between 7 and 8 for accompanied."""
+        session = make_session(capacity=10, admitted=0)
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer(age=7, accompanied=False)) == "refused"
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer(age=8, accompanied=False)) == "admitted"
+
+
+class TestSessionKinds:
+    def test_lane_session_end_to_end(self):
+        """Comprehensive lane session flow."""
+        session = make_session(kind="lane", capacity=3, admitted=0)
+        # 16+ member admitted
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Alice", age=16, member=True)) == "admitted"
+        session["admitted"] = 1
+        # 16+ member admitted
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Bob", age=25, member=True)) == "admitted"
+        session["admitted"] = 2
+        # under-16 refused
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Charlie", age=15)) == "refused"
+        # 16+ member admitted
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Diana", age=20, member=True)) == "admitted"
+        session["admitted"] = 3
+        # 16+ member waiting (full)
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Eve", age=20, member=True)) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_family_session_end_to_end(self):
+        """Comprehensive family session flow."""
+        session = make_session(kind="family", capacity=3, admitted=0)
+        # Accompanied young admitted
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Alice", age=5, accompanied=True)) == "admitted"
+        session["admitted"] = 1
+        # Unaccompanied young refused
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Bob", age=6, accompanied=False)) == "refused"
+        # Old admitted
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Charlie", age=20)) == "admitted"
+        session["admitted"] = 2
+        # Old non-member waiting (last place for member)
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Diana", age=30, member=False)) == "waiting"
+
+    def test_club_session_end_to_end(self):
+        """Comprehensive club session flow."""
+        session = make_session(kind="club", capacity=2, admitted=0)
+        # Member admitted
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Alice", member=True)) == "admitted"
+        session["admitted"] = 1
+        # Non-member refused
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Bob", member=False)) == "refused"
+        # Member admitted
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Charlie", member=True)) == "admitted"
+        session["admitted"] = 2
+        # Member waiting
+        assert admit(session, make_swimmer("Diana", member=True)) == "waiting"
+
+
+class TestMemberVsNonMemberPlaces:
+    def test_last_place_reserved_scenario(self):
+        """The classic last-place-for-member scenario."""
